capabilities.statement: Provide verification of a user's identity before any protected operation is allowed, as the system requires an authenticated identity as a precondition.
evidenceSpans: Students, professors, and academic administrators are specialized roles of a university user, and an authenticated identity and role are preconditions for protected operations.

capabilities.statement: Enforce role‑based permission checks for every protected operation, ensuring that only users with the appropriate university‑user role can perform the action.
evidenceSpans: The system shall authorize each protected operation according to the authenticated university‑user role.

capabilities.statement: Persist all core domain data (courses, offerings, terms, users, registrations, waitlist entries) so that it survives application and server restarts.
evidenceSpans: Course, offering, term, university‑user, registration, and waitlist information shall survive application and server restarts.

capabilities.statement: Guarantee correct handling of concurrent registration, swap, drop, and waitlist operations so that enrollment capacity, registration uniqueness, and waitlist ordering are preserved.
evidenceSpans: Concurrent registration, swap, drop, and waitlist operations shall preserve enrollment capacity, registration uniqueness, and waitlist ordering.
